name: Odile Gate
description: Odile Gate puts a key, an allow-list of calls, a rate limit, a loop breaker, held approvals on risky writes and an audit log in front of an HTTP API. These tools create a project and an app per agent, check the setup, read the audit log and explain refused calls. gate_create_project needs no sign-up or payment; the other tools take that project's admin key. Free for 3 apps and 10,000 calls a month; Pro is $29 a month.
